verdict.rationale: Recurly documents its own data import capability for bringing customer data into accounts, which covers the core of migrating records in. However, live subscription migration from a competing platform is not specifically documented, and the only card-portability mention is a community remark about the Recurly gateway, not documented PCI-compliant inbound card transfer. missing for 10: documented subscription import from spreadsheet or competitor, PCI-compliant card vault transfer process, evidence that migration is invisible to customers (no re-billing or re-authentication), hands-on migration corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate live subscriptions in from a spreadsheet or a competing platform — including PCI-compliant card data transfer — without customers noticing

citations.quote: Import customer data to populate accounts and records across your Recurly account.
